title: Haridas (Plate VII), from Honigberger's 'Thirty-five Years in the East', 1852
what_it_shows: Lithograph portrait captioned 'Haridas', Plate VII of Honigberger's 1852 book: an illustration, not a photograph
author: John Martin Honigberger (book); lithograph after a picture from Captain Gardner (per the book's plate notes)
attribution: 'Haridas', Plate VII in J. M. Honigberger, Thirty-five Years in the East (London, 1852). Public domain. Scan: Wellesley College Library / Internet Archive
notes: Full page scan, uncropped. Honigberger's plate notes say he never saw Haridas himself; the likeness came from Captain Gardner. The archive.org item has no licence field; the work is 1852 and public domain by age.

title: Page 127 of 'Thirty-five Years in the East' (1852): the start of the Haridas account
what_it_shows: Scanned book page (p.127) where Honigberger begins the story of the faqueer buried alive at Lahore
author: John Martin Honigberger
attribution: J. M. Honigberger, Thirty-five Years in the East (London, 1852), p.127. Public domain. Scan: Wellesley College Library / Internet Archive
notes: Text page; good for a slow push-in. The account continues on pp.128-130 (archive leaves n187-n189).

title: Title page of 'Thirty-five Years in the East' by John Martin Honigberger, 1852
what_it_shows: Scanned title page, London: H. Baillière, 1852; Honigberger is styled 'late physician to the court of Lahore'
author: John Martin Honigberger
attribution: Title page, J. M. Honigberger, Thirty-five Years in the East (London, 1852). Public domain. Scan: Wellesley College Library / Internet Archive

title: James Braid, 'Observations on Trance; or, Human Hybernation' (1850), p.11: Sir Claude Wade's account
what_it_shows: Scanned page of Braid's 1850 book with Sir Claude Wade's eyewitness statement about the fakeer disinterred before Runjeet Singh at Lahore
author: James Braid (quoting Sir Claude Martin Wade)
licence: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (stated on the archive.org item)
attribution: James Braid, Observations on Trance (London, 1850), p.11. Public domain. Royal College of Physicians of Edinburgh / Internet Archive
notes: The heading 'Replies to Dr Braid's queries regarding the Fakeer who buried himself' is on the previous page (leaf n11). The title page is leaf n2.

title: 'Fortress of the City of Lahore' (Plate XV), Honigberger 1852

attribution: 'Fortress of the City of Lahore', Plate XV in J. M. Honigberger, Thirty-five Years in the East (London, 1852). Public domain. Scan: Wellesley College Library / Internet Archive
notes: Fold-out plate; faint fold lines visible. Wide 2.2:1 image, good for a slow pan.
